// REQ: LANG-1311 LANG-1312 LANG-1313
use "collections"

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
actor Main
  let _env: Env

  new create(env: Env) =>
    _env = env
    let name: String = "world"
    let c: U8 = 'x'
    for i in Range(0, 3) do
      if (i > 0) and true then
        env.out.print("Hello, " + name + "!\n" + i.string())
      end
    end

  be greet(times: U32 = 0x1F) => None
